bio.text: Amanda McKinney, a Yakima County commissioner, advanced from the August 2026 primary for Washington's 4th Congressional District, where she faces Democrat John Duresky in November.
MyNorthwest described the seat as recently vacated, and McKinney received an endorsement from Donald Trump.
MyNorthwest reported that she worked in mortgage banking for more than two decades before entering politics.

sources.title: Trump-endorsed McKinney, Democrat Duresky advance in WA-4 primary to replace Newhouse - MyNorthwest.com
